correctness.rationale: The source GGWP Theorem 2.6 has positive survival equivalent P(T>t)~C t^(-1/beta), C>0. The exact tail-integral formula E(T^r)=r∫t^(r-1)P(T>t)dt shows E(T^r) finite iff r<1/beta, with log divergence at equality. Thus at beta=0.5 mean is finite but second moment and variance infinite; no finite population CV, skewness or kurtosis exists. Actual source Table 1 has FOUR parameter rows with beta=0.5 reporting finite variance, CV, skewness and kurtosis; manuscript prose claims all moments there. Source theorem and strict corollary contradict these assertions. An independent high-precision positive-tail constant calculation and boundary integral check corroborate normalization.
